Add get_sim, get_obs and get_stats accessor functions

This PR adds three new functions to retrieve data from the evaluation repository:

get_sim() returns simulated data, with optional filtering by species and USMs
get_obs() returns observed data, with optional filtering by species and USMs
get_stats() returns statistics for a given species

get_stats() supports lazy evaluation via the collect argument, returning either an Arrow dataset or a data.frame.
